Job Title: Quality Engineer
 Experience Level: 4-6 Years
 Work Mode - Remote
 Location: Remote
 Job Summary :
 We are looking for a skilled Quality Engineer to join our SAP Field Service Management (FSM) team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in automation testing, performance tracing, and end-to-end quality assurance. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions.
 Key Responsibilities :

• Develop and maintain automation test scripts using Selenium and Cypress. 

• Conduct end-to-end, regression, and functional testing to ensure product quality.

• Implement performance tracing and monitoring to identify bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with development teams to integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines .

• Ensure quality standards by designing and maintaining test plans, test cases, and test reports.

• Analyze defects, troubleshoot issues, and provide detailed documentation for resolution.

• Work with cross-functional teams to define and improve test strategies.

 Required Skills & Experience:

• 4-6 years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation.

• Strong expertise in Selenium, Cypress, and JavaScript/TypeScript/Python-based automation frameworks. 

• Experience in performance testing and tracing tools (e.g., Dynatrace, Grafana, or similar). 

• Familiarity with REST API testing using Postman or similar tools.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions). 

• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and test-driven development (TDD).

• Excellent analytical and debugging skills.

 Good to Have:

• Experience with SAP FSM or SAP ecosystem .

• Knowledge of cloud-based testing and containerization ( Docker, Kubernetes). 

• Exposure to security testing practices.
